desc: 纯白低帮系带板鞋，撞色几何台夏日视觉，逐层拆解内里大底与规格
leaf: 女款纯白平底系带休闲板鞋
name: 纯白平底系带小白鞋款

shots.intent: 首屏一眼点击：浅色撞色几何台上成双展示，用清新夏日色域建立第一好感。
shots.textZone: 顶部右三分区：主标题 + 一条短标签

shots.intent: 一秒讲清核心主张：正侧立面把鞋型轮廓与平底比例交代干净。
shots.textZone: 顶部横带：主标题 + 一个描边框标签

shots.intent: 放大夏季穿闭口鞋的真实摩擦点，让买家先对号入座再往下看方案。
shots.textZone: 底部居中：一条主痛点标题

shots.intent: 用微距证明鞋口包边与内里做工，把舒适主张落到可见证据上。
shots.textZone: 左下角：一条标签配细引线

shots.intent: 仰视把大底纹路与侧墙厚度摊开给买家看，回应防滑与轻量疑虑。
shots.textZone: 大底纹路右侧：一条短标签加细折线

shots.intent: 规格屏一次说清高度与参数区间，消掉买大买小的决策成本。
shots.textZone: 右侧两列参数清单 + 跟部竖向尺寸标注

shots.intent: 下半身实景穿搭让买家代入通勤与周末场景，同时不泄露模特身份。
宫格一次给完侧面、正面、底面与后跟四个视角，替代买家反复翻图。
shots.textZone: 每格下方一枚强调色标签芯片

shots.intent: 俯视平铺把随附物与做工证据摊开，用可见内容而非证书消除风险。
shots.textZone: 底部：三条细线图标短标签

shots.intent: 收口屏用同一色域重申主张并给出行动位，不靠虚构促销制造紧迫感。
shots.textZone: 上半区：主标题 + 一枚圆角行动按钮

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium spring-summer casual-footwear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean #FFFFFF, soft sky blue #C6E4F1 and pale blush #F8DDE1 as base fields, warm apricot #F7C9A4 as the single accent, deep charcoal #2D2D2D as the only ink color; cool-neutral bright tone at 5600K; modern geometric sans-serif for both Chinese and Latin copy, one headline plus one label per screen, no serif or handwritten faces; background system of flat matte color-block walls and simple geometric podium blocks, never random scenery or printed texture; lighting system of bright soft diffused daylight from the upper left with gentle contact shadows and no hard edges; layout system of generous margins, thin hairline rules, numbered circular markers and one callout leader style; icon system of thin single-weight line icons only, no 3D, no gradients, no shadows on icons; product presentation rules: true proportions, stable slight 3/4 or 90-degree side geometry, consistent scale and centering across all screens, both soles always grounded; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: true proportions and stable geometry: slight 3/4 front or clean 90-degree side, identical scale and centering across screens, both soles always grounded with a visible contact shadow
style.surfaceSystem: matte painted blocks and seamless paper ground, clean shelf band in #F2F0EE for spec screens
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for Chinese and Latin copy, deep charcoal #2D2D2D, one headline plus one label per screen, sizes 30-34pt headline / 12-15pt label, Chinese copy wrapped in corner brackets
